title: Bridge L2194, Carries 200th Avenue over unnamed stream, Magnolia, Rock County, MN
notes: Significance: Bridge L2194 is locally significant under National Register of Historic Places Criterion C in the area of Engineering as an example of the work of local bridge builder, Perley N. Gillham. The bridge is noted as being significant for displaying characteristic elements of Gillham's design style, including decorative coping and molding and solid railings with cylindrical rail posts. The bridge is also significant for being a distinctive example of Gillham's box culvert designs. This bridge is the last known Gillham bridge to be designed and constructed, and illustrates the full extent of his career in Rock County.
